d:
In this Ground Report from Election bound state Bihar, Khabargaon went to the Patna Junction and spoke to those migrants who are now going back to their respective cities i.e, their workplace. We tried to understand the plight of migration in Bihar and the reasons behind it.
We also spoke to the public as to what they think about the upcoming elections and which party do they think would work better for the state.
Reporter: Satyam
Camera: Abhishek
Video Editor: Aakash
